page.overview:
Who is Dawn?

Dawn appears in and is played by Hildur Ruriks.

Dawn is the secretary of Terence Wynn at Smith's Grove Sanitarium. When Dr. Wynn and Dr. Loomis asked her to give them any information the sanitarium had on Michael Myers, she informed them that the news just reported that they found Jamie Lloyd murdered.

In the Producer's Cut of the film, Dawn is revealed to be a member of the Cult of Thorn. She is present at the attempted sacrifice of Kara Strode and Steven Lloyd and stands with Mrs. Blankenship. When Tommy intervenes and holds a knife to Wynn's throat, Dawn and Blakenship give angry and worried looks. It is unclear if Dawn was a member of the Cult in the theatrical cut of the film, though it is implied, given Dr. Wynn's position in the Cult.
